unparseable: S6 row 1 -- an unparseable file (the four-forms text, carrying the most-resembled branch's error)
empty-file: S6 row 2 -- an empty file (the shipped `no records in <file>` refusal, EXIT_USAGE 2)
whitespace-only: S6 row 3 -- a file of only whitespace (the same shipped path, EXIT_USAGE 2)
as-omitted: S6 row 4 -- `--as` omitted on an input at least one value carries (S5.1's choice block, EXIT_USAGE 2)
json-inner-malformed: S6 row 5 -- a {label, descriptor} wrapper whose inner descriptor is malformed
bluewallet-no-name: S6 row 6 -- a BlueWallet file with no `Name:` header
bluewallet-no-format: S6 row 7 -- a BlueWallet file with no `Format:` header
bluewallet-zero-cosigners: S6 row 8 -- a BlueWallet file with zero cosigner lines (F-419)
bluewallet-policy-count: S6 row 9 -- a BlueWallet `Policy: k of n` with a different key count
bluewallet-no-origin: S6 row 10 -- BlueWallet keys with no origin path (no `Derivation:` at all, or after the cosigner lines)
bluewallet-bad-fingerprint: S6 row 11 -- a BlueWallet cosigner fingerprint that is not 8 hex characters
multi-under-descriptor: S6 row 12 -- `wsh(multi(...))` under `--as descriptor` (conjunct 1's permanent refusal)
miniscript: S6 row 13 -- a miniscript descriptor, either `--as`
md1-fixed-index: S6 row 14 -- a descriptor with `/0/*` under `--as md1` (S5.3(a))
key-count-exceeded: S6 row 17 -- `sortedmulti` with too many keys for its wrapper (conjunct 3)
key-identity: S6 row 18 -- two keys declaring the same origin with different xpubs (conjunct 8)
key-identity-duplicate: S6 row 19 -- the same key at the same derivation in two slots (conjunct 8)
mixed-network: S6 row 20 -- a multisig mixing mainnet and testnet keys (conjunct 5)
unsupported-key-version: S6 row 21 -- a descriptor or bare key using ypub/upub/vpub/Upub/Vpub (conjunct 4)
promotion-path-not-inferable: S6 row 23 -- a bare key whose origin path matches no promotable script
promotion-account-not-zero: S6 row 24 -- a bare key at account != 0
promotion-fingerprint-no-path: S6 row 25 -- a bare key with a fingerprint and no path
promotion-multisig-cosigner-key: S6 row 26 -- a bare `Zpub` / `Ypub` (a multisig cosigner key is not a wallet)
multi-in-single-key-script: S6 row 29 -- a single-key script wrapping a multi (conjunct 1)
key-in-script-slot: S6 row 30 -- a bare key in a script slot, `wsh(KEY)` / `sh(KEY)` (conjunct 1)
use-site-hardened: S6 row 31 -- a hardened use-site component (conjunct 7)
use-site-out-of-set: S6 row 33 -- any other use-site path shape (conjunct 7's closed set)
md1-no-wildcard: S6 row 34 -- a multipath with no trailing wildcard under `--as md1` (S5.3(a''))
multi-record-descriptor: S6 row 35 -- a multi-record input whose records include a descriptor, `--as` absent
